outputs.explanation: Panel A is a western blot, not a plot; individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B is a set of phase-contrast micrographs, not a plot; the check does not apply.

The top part shows flow cytometry density/scatter plots (exempt, as scatter data are themselves individual points). The bottom bar chart (mean ± SEM, n=3) overlays individual data points as distinct markers (circles, squares, triangles) for each replicate.
The top part shows flow cytometry density/scatter plots (exempt). The bottom bar chart (mean ± SD, n=3) shows individual replicate values as dots overlaid on each bar.
Panel E is a heatmap of normalized RNA-seq expression (Z-scores); heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel F is a western blot, not a plot; the check does not apply.
Both bar charts (mean ± SEM, n=3) for pluripotency and lineage marker genes show individual data points as distinct markers (circles, squares, triangles) overlaid on each bar.
Panel H is immunofluorescence micrograph imagery, not a plot; the check does not apply.
